scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: I believe that to make people remember you, it is definitely not by sending a text message asking 'How are you today?' or sending some very boring greetings. It must be that you did something to let people see your value, right?

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Well, then I'll share my process with everyone, okay? I'll tell you a process that is very important.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: When we contact a customer today, what we actually need to do is build a 'Heaven, Earth, and Human' network. We didn't have social media back then, but I created two things to build customer loyalty and increase contact points, because a sale is just the conversion of trust.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Trust comes from 100 small actions worth one point each. Those 100 actions come from increasing contact points and the duration of contact. So there is only one key focus: how to increase contact points. This is the only thing you need to remember.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: So when you encounter a customer, for example, a walk-in customer comes in and I exchange phone numbers with him. Within five minutes of him leaving, I must send a text message. That is the very first contact point.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Sending that text to his phone within five minutes—I can guarantee that even if he met ten salespeople that day, neither the second nor the third one did this. What's inside? Your name, phone number, a thank you, and most importantly, my social media handles.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: With social media, he might just click on it when he's free. He'll see the link, think 'I'll just follow you on FB.' Once he follows, he has entered my network. My two main traffic drivers are my personal brand media, which I start building from there.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: So every week, you must post, whether it's a story or a regular post. Your reach every week should be at least seven or eight times. This is essential. This is what we call passive reach.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: He won't feel you are being forced, but he keeps seeing you. If he doesn't like it, he'll just block you. What's the harm? It doesn't affect me, but he is still in my contacts. Even if he misses me on social media, my monthly text still reaches him. So he will see my name at least 15 times a year just from texts. Adding social media, that's 300 to 400 times a year. He has no choice but to remember me.
